title: Prepare a copy of personal data
confirm: I have verified this person and the approved scope of this request.
omit: Remove this text from the copy
reviewed: I have reviewed the exact data and removed other people's private information.
acknowledge: I understand that this copy does not complete the full request.
revokeConfirm: Stop future downloads; copies already downloaded cannot be recalled.
pending: The result is still being checked. Check the same request before trying again.
unavailable: This copy is unavailable. Return to the request for help.
saved: Change recorded. Review the current result below.
error: The change was not confirmed. Review the current data; if someone changed it, collect a fresh draft.
supplementConfirm: This is a reviewed redacted copy for this exact recipient and request; it excludes the original and other people’s private data.
refreshInventory: Refresh sources and clear prior decisions
inventoryHelp: Each category needs a supported decision. Empty means the captured source inventory is empty. Additional or inaccessible material remains unresolved.
sourceUnknown: This category has additional or inaccessible material. Its sources and counts are hidden; keep it held or unsupported.
sourceProof: Reviewed redacted copy or withholding notice for this source
evidenceReference: Supporting review evidence reference; do not include private record details
decisionConfirm: I reviewed this exact category and its source evidence for this recipient. This records my decision; it does not approve legal policy.
manifestStale: The source inventory or permissions changed. Collect a fresh draft before reviewing or delivering it.
readyScope: The declared categories have supported decisions. Delivery and completion still require current source and access checks.
disclosureCategory: Category covered by this reviewed copy
completeConfirm: I checked every declared category and the exact current delivery. Unresolved categories prevent completion.

categories.personal_activity: Own profile, contacts, choices and authored activity
categories.joint_records_and_received_communication: Shared business records and received communications

dispositions.none: No sources in this captured category

bases.no_sources: No sources in the captured inventory

completedScope: Completion is recorded for this reviewed declared scope. This does not certify legal compliance or close other privacy requests.
